ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels and 15% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central white contiguous region. Continuous thick black band along the trailing edge. A distinct black wedge-like feature at the center notch. Isolated black circular spot located on the lower left lobe margin. Scattered small-scale dark focal spots across the central white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations appearing as sharp, irregular peaks and valleys across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory on the trailing edge moving from the distal tips toward the median notch, with convex curvature on the outer terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white and brown pixel clusters (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes. Multiple small circular depressions visible across the white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear marks including a vertical scratch on the inner right lobe and multiple faint horizontal and curved rake-like disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips; large irregular black pigmentation patch on the lower left margin resembling a focal trauma mark or unique pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex, tower-like black pigmentation pattern extending vertically from the fluke insertion toward the median notch.
